candidate_relations.reason: The benchmark diagnosis is Kawasaki disease. MIS-C is an important related differential with overlapping fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, rash, and conjunctivitis, but it is not the same diagnostic entity; the record also does not establish antecedent SARS-CoV-2 infection.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct COVID-19-associated inflammatory syndrome that overlaps clinically with Kawasaki disease.
